review_comments.body: **Deleted items can return** If `DATABASE_REPLICA_URL` is set and the replica lags, deleting the Redis key lets the next request to `/q/[slug]` or `/p/[slug]` read the old row and cache it for another 24 hours. Deleted items can keep being served, and edited links can keep redirecting to the old address. Make cache refills after a write read current data, and prevent removed slugs from being cached again. Apply this to both helpers. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Database layer](https://app.greptile.com/personal-org-19816/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/umami-software/umami/-/docs/database-layer.md)

**Old short URLs survive** If the configured replica lags an earlier rename, `getLink` can return the wrong previous slug. For example, if the primary and cache contain slug B but the replica still has A, renaming the link to C deletes only A and C. The cached B remains usable for up to 24 hours. `updatePixel` has the same problem. Read the previous slug from the primary together with the update, so the removed key matches the row being changed. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Database layer](https://app.greptile.com/personal-org-19816/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/umami-software/umami/-/docs/database-layer.md)

Confidence Score: 3/5

**[Medium impact]** The changes affect short\-link and pixel requests when Redis is enabled\. Fix the two replica-related cache gaps before merging.

Findings

1.  **Deleted items can return** ▶ 2.  **Old short URLs survive** ▶

Summary

This PR removes cached links and pixels after updates and deletes. - Link changes clear the Redis entries for their slugs. - Pixel changes clear the Redis entries for their slugs.

Diagram

 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Admin participant Primary participant Redis participant Visitor participant Replica Admin->>Primary: Update or delete item Primary-->>Admin: Write succeeds Admin->>Redis: Delete slug key Visitor->>Redis: Request slug Redis-->>Visitor: Cache miss Visitor->>Replica: Find slug Replica-->>Visitor: Old row before replication catches up Visitor->>Redis: Cache old row for 24 hours ```
